params.body:
Five findings around the dealer logo, reported by Frederik and Shane on cutover day. ## Order PDF: no logo, first page nearly empty (order 2460) Since 2026-07-30 the order, offer, loan and history PDF blades wrote `src="@{{ base64_encode($logoData) }}"`. To Blade `@{{` is an escape, so the attribute held that literal text: TCPDF found no image and the header cell with the failed image took a whole page (the fixture document has 5 pages with the old blade, 4 without a logo). All four blades now use `PdfImage::src()` like the poster does since #428; with a logo the order has exactly as many pages as without. ## `dealer/image` route: 500 instead of 404, response object cached `Storage::get()` returns null for a missing file, so `Image::make(null)` threw "Image source not readable" as a 500. `cachedImageFromDisk` now caches bytes + mime for a day (no GD re-encode), answers 404 for a missing or non-image file without caching the miss, and logs disk + path so the next occurrence names what was asked for. ## Seller logo on the detail card and list cards `h-12 w-12 object-contain` turned a 1920×387 logo into a 48×10 strip. The logo sits in a fixed 72px box (`.ui-seller-logo`, white ground, hairline; 52px on the list card) so a wide logo scales to the width and a square one to the height. ## Iframe "Stel een vraag" form The theme's content-box sizing plus 11px padding pushed every `width: 100%` field 22px past the modal. The form is now a centred column of at most 480px, everything border-box, labels 8px above their field, checkboxes aligned with their text, buttons in one row. ## Showroom slide header (Shane) Logo in a box of at most 360×120px without white ground (transparent PNGs sit on the dark band), never cropped; name and address as three right-aligned lines (street + number / postal code + city, no comma). Columns 8/4 instead of 9/3 to make room. Rule S2-7.14 updated accordingly. ## Poster header (Shane) The stray `
` above the logo is gone; the logo sits left in a bounded cell (max 260×45px, scaled from the real dimensions), the address right. The version line ("Longitude FWD") was drawn by the controller at an absolute Y after `writeHTML`, which overlapped the title once the logo rendered again; it is now part of the HTML under the title. ## PDF controllers return a response `OfferController`, `OrderController` (order and history) and `RentalController` still ended in `PDF::Output($name)`, TCPDF echoing to the output stream (that is what dumped `%PDF-1.7 …` into the phpunit console). They now return `PdfResponse::inline(PDF::Output('', 'S'), …)` like #429 did for the poster and the energy card; `RentalDocumentTest` asserts on the response body instead of buffering the console. ## Tests `tests/Feature/DealerLogoTest.php` (8 tests): the three PDF blades carry the base64 logo, a missing logo leaves the tag out, the order PDF has the same page count with and without a logo (4), the image route serves the PNG twice (second from cache) and 404s on a miss without caching it, the poster header has no rule and the version follows the title, and the poster renders as a PDF. Filter `Image|Dealer|Order|Pdf|Buybox|Stocklist|Website|Lead|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|Rental|Offer|Showroom` green locally, except pre-existing environment failures (`SmokeTest` on `media_version` before the migration ran, `PhotoSelectAllTest` on an uncommitted `public/js` vendor copy). Finding: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-dealerlogo-bestelbon-kaart-en-vraagformulier.md`. Screenshots (before/after): contact form 1440, seller card, showroom slide header 1920, poster first page.
params.title: The dealer logo prints on the order, sizes right on the card, and the iframe question form aligns
